goal: Implement Slice S1 of Initiative lane-mode-followups: scripts/verify-batch-completion.ts verifies a completed lane-mode (batch_run_state v2) batch from the recorded state, report and batch-branch Git objects instead of failing read_failed.

acceptance.assertion: Per Interfaces and the consumer list of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes) (source: repository evidence, Review of parallel-batch-lanes-s2-lane-integration finding review-3 and review-4 of PBL-S2-A2): the completion verifier reads a v2 batch record and its lane report (handoffs[] in place of handoff) and returns complete:true for a lane-mode batch whose every child is integrated or released, its commits are one per child on the batch branch in order, each commit carries the Immune-Brain-Batch trailer, the imm(<task_id>) subject and a single-parent lineage from the recorded base head, each child's .imm/audit/<task_id>/<run>/ pair is in that commit and agrees with its terminal proof, and the changed paths stay in the child's scope. Positive: a real lane-mode fixture (second Git worktree, integrated children) verifies complete:true with one entry per child. Negative: a v2 batch not completed, a child neither integrated nor released, a commit order or parent mismatch, a missing or foreign audit pair, an out-of-scope path and a malformed lane report each fail with the existing stable code for that condition and never read_failed; a v2 record is never parsed as v1. Bound: every existing v1 verification result and exit status is byte-identical to before this Slice. Agreed seams: tests/batch-completion-verifier.test.ts, tests/pi-batch-acceptance-integration.test.ts.
